notes.title: patch 2.02
notes.content: Fixed New game not clearing all saved data.

notes.title: Version 2.0
notes.content:
Performance updates
New and updated stores
Level up system
New quests and collectibles
Food no longer respawns
All the guns are now spread out and not all are in the gun store

Fixed a major bug with males not spawning correctly

notes.title: Zombie animation patch
notes.content: fixed the issue where zombie animation got stuck after landing

notes.title: Performance update
notes.content: adjusted the draw distance on some items so they do not disappear when too close

notes.title: Weapon patch
notes.content:
Weapons no longer only do damage based on swinging speed but swinging speed * object weight.

Fixed an issue where some weapons would never break.

notes.title: zombie patch
notes.content: Fixed an issue where zombies would only target the player.

notes.title: Zombie update 2
notes.content: Zombies now eat the survivors when they die!

notes.title: Zombie Update
notes.content: The zombie's animations have been updated including over 12 new attacks. Act more like zombies.

notes.title: Lost update
notes.content: Fixed an issue where lost survivors were not being saved and would be counted again.

notes.title: Survivor patch
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where not all survivors would spawn if the game was restarted.

Fixed an issue with the endgame repeating

notes.title: End game patch
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the player teleported to an incorrect position at the end of the game.

Fixed a collision issue with multiple static objects.
